newsitem.title: CZECH REPUBLIC: PRESS DIGEST - CZECH REPUBLIC - JULY 21.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - CZECH REPUBLIC - JULY 21.

text.p: HOSPODARSKE NOVINY - Despite heavy rain throughout the weekend and numerous warnings, the floods did not worsen over the weekend, and the situation even began to stabilise in some areas. The floods took the lives of 46 people, wounded 2,500, affected 80,000, evacuated 10,000, destroyed 1,600 homes and otherwise damaged 10,000. Agriculture Minister Josef Lux estimates damages at 50 to 100 billion crowns.
- The Finance Ministry authorised Ceska Sporitelna to issue so-called flood bonds. Printing of the bonds has already begun.

- Prime Minister Vaclav Klaus said it was premature to consider an unplanned tax increase to cover flood damages. It will depend greatly on the success of the sale of flood bonds. The Finance Ministry should present an analysis of the extent of damages on August 13.
- At the end of last week, Skoda Plzen signed a contract with the Polish energy concern Elektri-Megadex to build an electricity and heating plant for Polish Katovice for 450 million crowns.

- According to the logistics director at Prerovske Strojirny, it will take two to three months to completely renew production in this machine tools company. Preliminary estimates show property damages of 350 to 450 million crowns caused by the floods.
MLADA FRONTA DNES - An inspection team lead by United States experts will fly to Prague today to inspect the number and the safety of weapons for some units of the Czech army.
- Net income for households increased year-on-year during the first quarter of this year by between 7.4 percent and 12.8 percent.

- Two significant shareholders of dairy Olmy Olomouc, Milkagro and ZD Uncovice, transferred 51 percent of shares of the dairy to Body International Brokers, which should obtain financing for them to cover flood damages.
- During the first half of this year, a total of 90,405 new passenger vehicles were sold, 54.98 percent from domestic manufacturers.
- Jihoceska Energetika accepted the proposal of the National Property Fund, which holds a 46.7-percent stake, and decided not to pay dividends from its net profits of 424.6 million crowns from 1996.
PRAVO - The Finance Ministry's Securities Office began forced administration of Investment Fund CKD Kutna Hora on Friday.

- A new law on banks, which will be proposed to the cabinet in the next few days, should separate credit and investment operations and form more specific regulations for banks' capital activities outside the banking sector.
LIDOVE NOVINY - Last year, domestic investment funds and investment companies had total losses of 28.4 billion crowns. Of all 422 funds and companies, 305 (72.3 percent) were loss-making.

- Trade with EU countries increased between January and May year-on-year by 7.5 percent to 358.8 billion crowns. Czech exports increased by 9.2 percent to 158.2 billion crowns, and imports, by six percent to 200.6 billion crowns.
- Glass maker Sklarny Kavalier Sazava was fined 300,000 crowns by the Anti-monopoly Office for illegal price agreements it made with distributors of its products.
- Gas companies which are members of the Czech Gas Union are offering help to Severomoravska Plynarenska and Jihomoravska Plynarenska, which operate in areas affected by the floods.
